# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.2 Stage 3 Package 3, Italian Wars Byzantine Intervention (oe_itw_, slot 55). Generated by gen_italian_wars_byz.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Increment sent event counter safely.
oe_itw_inc_sent = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_itw_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
}

# Any scope. Increment Italian intervention influence score safely.
oe_itw_add_inf = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_itw_influence } change_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_influence add = $amt$ } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_influence value = $amt$ } }
}

# Country scope. Apply opinion modifier to an Italian/Western tag if extant and distinct from root.
oe_itw_opn_tag = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:$tag$ NOT = { this = c:$tag$ } }
        c:$tag$ = { add_opinion = { modifier = $mod$ target = root } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Resolve live Eastern Roman host (prefer ROM over BYZ).
oe_itw_resolve_host = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { oe_itw_host_ready = yes } }
        c:ROM = { save_scope_as = oe_itw_tmp_host }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_host value = scope:oe_itw_tmp_host }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { oe_itw_host_ready = yes } }
        c:BYZ = { save_scope_as = oe_itw_tmp_host }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_host value = scope:oe_itw_tmp_host }
    }
    else = {
        remove_global_variable = oe_itw_host
    }
}

# Any scope. One-time initialization of the Italian Wars Byzantine Intervention line.
oe_itw_init_line = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_stance value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_influence value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_outcome value = 0 }
    oe_itw_resolve_host = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_itw_has_host = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_on value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_end value = 8 }
    }
}

# Any scope. Expire closed windows and dispatch at most one Italian Wars event per 18 months.
oe_itw_dispatch_events = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_1 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_1 ?= 2 } current_year > 1515 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_fired_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_2 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_2 ?= 2 } current_year > 1522 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_fired_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_3 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_3 ?= 2 } current_year > 1528 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_fired_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_4 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_4 ?= 2 } current_year > 1534 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_fired_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_5 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_5 ?= 2 } current_year > 1542 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_fired_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_6 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_6 ?= 2 } current_year > 1546 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_fired_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_7 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_7 ?= 2 } current_year > 1554 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_fired_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_8 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_fired_8 ?= 2 } current_year > 1568 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_fired_8 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_itw_ev_m }
                global_var:oe_itw_m >= { value = global_var:oe_itw_ev_m add = 18 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_itw_open_1 = yes oe_itw_has_host = yes }
            random = {
                chance = 20
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_fired_1 value = 1 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_ev_m value = global_var:oe_itw_m }
                oe_itw_inc_sent = yes
                global_var:oe_itw_host = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itw.1 }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_itw_open_2 = yes oe_itw_has_host = yes }
            random = {
                chance = 12
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_fired_2 value = 1 }

                oe_itw_inc_sent = yes
                global_var:oe_itw_host = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itw.2 }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_itw_open_3 = yes oe_itw_has_host = yes }

                chance = 12
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_fired_3 value = 1 }

                oe_itw_inc_sent = yes

            }
        }
        else_if = {

# Public monthly entry point for reserved scheduler slot 55 (gen_mainline_lock.py).
# Idempotent per calendar month via oe_itw_ran_m; paired with lightweight fallback pulse oe_itw_pulse.txt.
oe_itw_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_m value = oe_itw_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_itw_era_open = yes
            NOT = { global_var:oe_itw_ran_m ?= global_var:oe_itw_m }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_ran_m value = global_var:oe_itw_m }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_itw_init } }
            oe_itw_init_line = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_itw_end ?= 8 current_year <= 1568 }
            oe_itw_resolve_host = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_itw_has_host = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_end value = 0 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_on value = 1 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_itw_on }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year > 1570 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_end value = 3 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_itw_on
            }
            else = {
                oe_itw_resolve_host = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_itw_has_host = yes }
                    oe_itw_dispatch_events = yes
                }
                else = {
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_end value = 8 }
                    remove_global_variable = oe_itw_on
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    remove_country_modifier = oe_itw_end_exarchate
    remove_country_modifier = oe_itw_end_balance
    remove_country_modifier = oe_itw_end_withdrawal
    remove_country_modifier = oe_itw_stratioti_levy
    remove_country_modifier = oe_itw_italian_envoy
    remove_country_modifier = oe_itw_exarchate_seat
}

oe_itw_test_start = {
    oe_itw_test_clear = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_stance value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_influence value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_outcome value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_test_mode value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_itw_m value = oe_itw_m_now }
    oe_itw_resolve_host = yes
}

oe_itw_test_month = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_itw_ran_m
    oe_itw_monthly = yes
}

oe_itw_test_me_1 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_itw_on } } oe_itw_test_start = yes }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_itw.1
}
